description: Move completed tasks older than a specified number of days from one list to another (archive) list. Useful for cleaning up active lists while preserving historical tasks.

dryRun.description: If true, only preview what would be archived without making changes

olderThanDays.description: Archive tasks completed more than this many days ago (default: 90)

sourceListId.description: ID of the source list to archive tasks from

targetListId.description: ID of the target archive list

name: archive-completed-tasks
